subject: closing-tasks-with-approvals
detail: In A anyone allowed to edit a task can move it to done at any time. B's approvals were standalone. Once approvals attach to tasks, a task could be closed while its approval is still pending.
solutions: Block moving a task to done while it has a pending approval
Allow it and cancel the pending approval automatically
recommended: Block moving to done while an approval is pending; the approver decides first
